lib/api.js: on 401 the interceptor clears whichever token was used. If a request had BOTH X-Admin-Token AND Authorization (e.g., admin browsing the crew app), a 401 from /api/auth/me will wipe the admin token too. Low risk in practice but worth noting.
ACCESS_TOKEN_MINUTES=10080 (7d) is generous for a safety app accessed from shared field devices — consider 60min access + sliding refresh.

rca of the issue: User-reported bug: 'Login failed — check connection' on iOS Safari at mascidocs.com. RCA: Cloudflare/Emergent ingress was overwriting the backend Access-Control-Allow-Origin header to '*'. Combined with axios withCredentials:true (needed for the previous httpOnly cookie auth), browsers reject every response per CORS spec because '*' + credentials is illegal. Fix verified: axios withCredentials:false + Authorization Bearer header from localStorage (masci_jwt_v1). No backend changes needed — auth.py already accepted Bearer as a fallback to the cookie. Verified end-to-end on preview URL with 0 cookie headers in the network capture.
